feature_preprocessing.note: sqa_features.combined_vector (per-modality SQI pack ++ advanced dynamics/HOS); pure numpy (numpy.rfft only); graph z-scores x_raw and standardizes x_feat (baked).

calibration.evaluation_partition: validation (store_v3) — the same split the temperature grid was minimized on; see held_out_ece for the held-out measurement
calibration.partition_note: the ECE pairs above are measured on the SAME validation split the temperature grid was minimized on, so the post-scaling number is an optimization minimum and optimistic. held_out_ece below is the held-out measurement, and it is the worst of the four shipped cards: no unseen-SUBJECT population of the training cohorts exists at all (every store_v3 EDA subject survives into store_v8 test), so the only held-out EDA windows are two cohorts store_v3 never had -- and there the grade head's post-scaling ECE is 0.5496 with 10.9% accuracy, i.e. the temperature makes calibration WORSE (0.4549 -> 0.5496) off-cohort.

held_out_ece.partition: data/store_v8 test split, restricted to subjects absent from both the train and val partitions of data/store_v3 (this graph's training store)
held_out_ece.population_kind: cross_cohort: every unseen subject belongs to PPG-DaLiA (EDA) or WESAD (EDA), cohorts absent from store_v3 -- so this is a cross-cohort number, NOT a within-distribution held-out one

full_store_v8_test_partition.why_not_the_headline: 50.1% of these windows belong to subjects that were in store_v3's train or val partition; the other 49.9% are the two unseen cohorts, so this partition is a 50/50 blend of seen subjects and off-cohort ones and is not a held-out figure either way

held_out_ece.reading: EDA is the modality with no honest in-distribution held-out calibration number available from the locked corpus. Both populations reported here already exceed the validation ECE by 3x-7x. Treat the shipped 0.0786 as a fit-partition figure only.
held_out_ece.pair_convention: [pre_scaling, as_shipped], same as grade_ece/usable_ece above. The graph emits raw_logits/T, so the pre-scaling logits are recovered exactly as graph_logits * T -- no model was loaded and the baked-in temperature is unchanged.
held_out_ece.estimator: biosqa.xdomain.calibration.expected_calibration_error at its default n_bins=15 (equal-width top-1-confidence bins) -- the same function and bin count that produced grade_ece/usable_ece above, so the two columns are comparable
held_out_ece.measured_by: scripts/measure_heldout_calibration.py (onnxruntime forward over this .onnx; trains nothing, exports nothing)

routing: grade+usable <- raw trunk fused with host combined SQI+dynamics vector; grade = ordinal ordered-logit

input_contract.reports: quality of the signal AS PROVIDED — if the input was pre-filtered, this is the post-filter quality
input_contract.caveat: a pre-filtered but still-corrupted signal can be under-flagged (false-clean): an aggressive low-pass/band-limit strips the high-frequency cues the model keys on. The app runs biosqa.inference.prefilter.detect_prefiltering() to warn when the input looks pre-filtered.
